security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown links, prompt examples, public homepage metadata, and SEO terminology. I confirmed two medium-risk command-execution surfaces where the skill asks agents to run local Python helper scripts against supplied URLs. No prompt injection attempt, credential access, or data-exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running python3 helper scripts, and explain that bundled connector code will process the supplied URL.

remediation.issue: Remote page retrieval through helper tools
remediation.suggestion: Keep robots.txt preflight, reject private or intranet URLs by default, and ask before using rendered-page fallback services.
Label prompt examples and repository links clearly as documentation so automated scanners can distinguish them from executable commands.

content.value_statement: Single-page SEO issues can hide behind weak titles, headings, links, and image signals. This skill produces a scored audit with prioritized fixes.
actual_capabilities: Scores title tags, meta descriptions, headers, keyword placement, internal links, images, and page-level tags.
Infers a provisional target keyword when one is missing and labels the result as estimated.
Produces element scores, an overall score, P0/P1/P2 fixes, and a handoff summary.
Supports single-page audits, competitor comparisons, pre-publish reviews, and bulk audit workflows.
Routes crawl, indexing, Core Web Vitals, and full E-E-A-T reviews to related specialist skills.
limitations: It does not replace a full technical SEO crawl or Core Web Vitals audit.
Estimated keywords and unavailable metrics should be validated with SEO tools or Search Console.
Raw fetches can miss schema injected by client-side JavaScript.
Bulk recommendations are sampled and should be confirmed before site-wide rollout.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a ranking drop
use_cases.description: Audit a single URL for structural SEO weaknesses after traffic or rankings decline.

use_cases.title: Prepare content for publication
use_cases.description: Check a draft for title, meta, heading, keyword, link, and image improvements before launch.

use_cases.title: Prioritize template fixes
use_cases.description: Sample a group of URLs and identify repeated on-page problems across a content type.

prompt_templates.title: Basic page audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the on-page SEO for this URL: [URL]. Target keyword: [keyword].

prompt_templates.title: Pre-publish content review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this draft for on-page SEO before publication. Target keyword: [keyword]. Page type: [blog post, product page, or landing page]. Content: [paste content].

prompt_templates.title: Competitor comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the on-page SEO of my page [URL] against this competitor [URL] for [keyword]. Show the strongest gaps and the first fixes to make.

prompt_templates.title: Bulk cluster audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Bulk audit these URLs by page type and cluster. Sample 2 to 3 pages per cluster, report confidence for extrapolated findings, and prioritize site-wide fixes: [URL list or sitemap section].

output_examples.input: Audit a blog post targeting best noise cancelling headphones.
output_examples.output: The report scores the title, meta description, H1, H2 coverage, keyword placement, links, images, and schema. It highlights missing alt text, thin internal links, and a stronger meta description as the first fixes.

output_examples.input: Review a draft article with no stated keyword.
output_examples.output: The skill infers a likely target keyword from the title, H1, opening text, and headings. It marks the keyword as estimated and adds keyword validation as an open loop.

output_examples.input: Audit 40 blog posts in one section.
output_examples.output: The skill groups pages by template, samples representative URLs, reports repeated title and heading patterns, and separates cluster-level fixes from single-page fixes.

best_practices: Provide the URL or content, target keyword, page type, and business goal.
Validate estimated keywords and metrics with Search Console or an SEO tool before major changes.
Confirm JavaScript-injected schema in the rendered DOM before reporting it as missing.
anti_patterns: Treating raw fetched HTML as the complete rendered page.
Using this audit as a full E-E-A-T publish-readiness verdict.
Applying sampled bulk recommendations to every page without confidence notes.

faq.question: What does this skill audit?
faq.answer: It audits page-level SEO signals such as titles, meta descriptions, headings, keywords, links, images, canonical tags, and schema presence.

faq.question: Can it audit a page without a keyword?
faq.answer: Yes. It can infer a provisional keyword from the page content and mark the result as estimated.

faq.question: Does it run a full technical SEO crawl?
faq.answer: No. Use a technical SEO checker for crawl depth, indexing, Core Web Vitals, mobile rendering, and HTTPS checks.

faq.question: Can it compare my page with a competitor?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide both URLs and the target keyword so it can compare page-level elements and prioritized gaps.

faq.question: Does it support bulk audits?
faq.answer: Yes. It can group many URLs by content type, sample pages, and report pattern-level recommendations with confidence notes.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible skill hosts.
